title: Principal Engineer, Data Science AI Architect
description:
**Company Description**

**We're Nagarro,** we are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18000+ experts across 40 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

 **Job Description**

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Total experience 11+ years.
* Must have experience to design, build and run GenAI and Agentic AI solutions inside enterprise systems, fitting AI into existing systems, security rules and budgets.
* Must have ability to translate ambiguous business problems into durable technical architectures.
* Must have strong ML fundamentals; how models are trained, tested and compared; spotting overfitting and weak data, deep learning basics; embeddings, classification, ranking models
* Should be able to architect and implement scalable ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions (LLMs, RAG, autonomous agents) aligned with business objectives.
* Must have experience in data science, ML engineering or AI architecture, with at least 5 years leading ML solutions from design to production.
* Should have expertise in Python, SQL and Solid statistics, including outlier detection and error metrics
* Should have exposure to time series forecasting.
* Should have production experience with regression and tabular ML: feature engineering, model selection, calibration, uncertainty (conformal or quantile intervals) and explainability (SHAP, coefficients).
* Must have experience with hierarchical forecasting or reconciliation, and prompt-injection testing.
* Should have hands-on experience with embeddings, vector search and hybrid retrieval, and with LLM applications: tool calling, retrieval-grounded generation, citations, guardrails and evaluation.
* Should have hands-on experience for building conversational agent, with multi-turn session memory and tool calling into the multiple engines and the semantic layer.
* Must have experience on a major cloud: pipelines, model registry, drift monitoring, retraining and low-latency serving.
* Should have experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Gemini, Vector Search), or equivalent on another cloud.
* Design retrieval-grounded generation with citations, input and output guardrails, human approval for actions, and layered, attack-tested prompt-injection protection

**ESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Understanding the client’s business use cases and technical requirements and be able to convert them into technical design which elegantly meets the requirements.
* Lead the design and implementation of complex GenAI workflows that combine LLMs, tools, APIs, structured data, and user context.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for prompt design, model integration, evaluation, and observability.
* Drive GenAI platform building reusable components, SDKs, and frameworks used across multiple teams or products.
* Partner with product, design, data, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions.
* Review critical designs and codebases, unblock teams on complex technical challenges, and raise the overall engineering bar.
* Lead technical discovery and solutioning for high-impact initiatives, including client or executive-facing workshops when required.
* Ensure enterprise readiness: security, privacy, compliance, governance, and responsible AI practices.
* Mapping decisions with requirements and be able to translate the same to developers.
* Identifying different solutions and being able to narrow down the best option that meets the client’s requirements.
* Defining guidelines and benchmarks for NFR considerations during project implementation
* Writing and reviewing design document explaining overall architecture, framework, and high-level design of the application for the developers
* Reviewing architecture and design on various aspects like extensibility, scalability, security, design patterns, user experience, NFRs, etc., and ensure that all relevant best practices are followed.
* Developing and designing the overall solution for defined functional and non-functional requirements; and defining technologies, patterns, and frameworks to materialize it
* Understanding and relating technology integration scenarios and applying these learnings in projects
* Resolving issues that are raised during code/review, through exhaustive systematic analysis of the root cause, and being able to justify the decision taken.
* Carrying out POCs to make sure that suggested design/technologies meet the requirements.

 **Qualifications**

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Data ScientistJob Title: Senior Data Engineer, Value Quantification – Product Data & Analytics (CNPF)  
  
Product Data & Analytics is a centralized global team that enables Mastercard product business units to make better data‑driven decisions. We build internal analytics partnerships that strengthen focus on business performance, portfolio and revenue optimization, initiative tracking, new product development, and go‑to‑market strategies. These capabilities are underpinned by our data platforms that enable insights to be delivered in a standardized, scalable, and cost‑efficient manner.  
  
Key Responsibilities  
  
Strategic Support  

* Design and implement value enablement frameworks that optimize pricing strategies, enhance pre-sales propositions, and ensure customer success.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams to tailor solutions that meet regional business needs and align with Mastercard's objectives.
* Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to optimize pricing, pre-sales strategies, and customer success outcomes.
* Develop frameworks, project structures, and presentations to communicate key strategic initiatives.
* Conduct data integrity checks and ensure quality and reliability in data used for analysis.
* Translate complex business problems into analytical solutions that support strategic decision-making.

  
Technical Leadership  

* Lead the development of advanced analytics tools, such as ROI calculators and value dashboards, to measure and optimize business performance.
* Utilize Python, SQL, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) for data analysis, modeling, and visualization.
* Create dynamic, interactive dashboards to provide stakeholders with actionable insights.
* Integrate AI/ML models to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of analytical tools (good-to-have, not mandatory).
* Drive process efficiency and scalability through automation and advanced analytics techniques.

  
Value Enablement Initiatives  

* Develop frameworks for measuring and tracking customer value realization.
* Design predictive models and real-time insights to create tailored customer solutions and business cases.
* Build self-service analytics tools to empower stakeholders with actionable insights.
* Encourage a culture of innovation by promoting participation in Sandbox challenges and regular brainstorming sessions.
* Develop flexible and agile solutions based on a deep understanding of business goals and market context.

  
Collaboration & Team Enablement  

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of strategic initiatives and projects.
* Foster a collaborative and innovative environment, promoting knowledge sharing and teamwork.
* Lead working sessions to drive alignment and productivity within the team.
* Provide mentorship and feedback to support team members' professional development.
* Lead internal training and enablement efforts on analytics tools and methodologies.

  
Stakeholder Management  

* Manage and implement roadmaps for strategic projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities.
* Engage regularly with stakeholders, ensuring effective communication of project progress and addressing escalations.
* Lead standups and project meetings, ensuring clear articulation of agendas, action items, and next steps.

  
Qualifications  
  
Experience  

* 5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, pricing strategy, customer success, or related fields, ideally within the payments, financial services, or technology sectors (experience in payments industry is a strong plus).
* Proven track record of developing and scaling data-driven tools and frameworks with measurable outcomes.
* Experience in using Python, SQL, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) for building analytics solutions.
* Experience integrating AI/ML models to enhance predictive insights and automate workflows is a good-to-have.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for data analysis, reporting, and presentation development.

  
Skills  

* Strong technical acumen with the ability to design and implement advanced analytics and visualization solutions.
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to derive actionable insights from complex data sets.
* Clear and concise communication skills, with the ability to translate technical insights into business impact for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively within cross-functional teams and promote a knowledge-sharing environment.
* Deep understanding of pricing strategies, customer success enablement, and revenue optimization principles.

  
Education  

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
* Advanced degrees (MBA, Master’s, or certifications in analytics, data science) are preferred

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Analyst - Data Scientist Machine Learning
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.  
  
Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**Description**
---------------

**Team Overview**

United Airlines' Digital Fleet Management department partners with Technical Operations leaders across the company to transform data and analytics into operational solutions. The team develops analytical products and data-driven insights that improve fleet performance and maintenance operations. This role requires strong analytical capability, product-development thinking, strategic problem solving, and effective relationships with internal and external partners.

**Role Overview**

The Analyst - Data Scientist will support both data analytics use cases and analytical product development. The role is responsible for work across the full lifecycle, including problem definition, data extraction and analysis, model development, productization, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of production-grade analytical products and dashboards that support operational decisions.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and deploy analytical products that apply data analysis, statistical modeling, machine learning, and optimization to business and operational problems.
* Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate data analytics use-cases into clear requirements, scalable solutions, and measurable outcomes
* Own work from concept through execution, including data preparation, prototyping, validation, productization, documentation, monitoring, and continuous improvement
* Analyze complex, high-volume data to identify patterns, generate actionable insights, and clearly communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences

**This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd - a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**

* Bachelor's degree
* Quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline
* 2+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, or analytical product development
* Strong Python or SQL skills and hands-on experience with predictive modeling and machine learning
* Experience manipulating and analyzing complex, high-volume, and high-dimensional data from multiple sources
* Ability to translate business problems into analytics use cases, product requirements, and measurable success criteria
* Practical understanding of the analytical product lifecycle, including prototyping, validation, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and enhancement
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and data-querying tools
* Working knowledge of distributed data-processing technologies such as Spark
* Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner and collaborate with business, data engineering, and technology teams
* Familiarity with Generative AI concepts and prompt writing
* Exposure to AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and NotebookLM
* Exhibit written and spoken English fluency

**What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):**

* Master's degree
* Experience developing and supporting production analytical products through their lifecycle
* Experience with Palantir Foundry, including data pipelines, ontology-based applications, Workshop, or related application-development capabilities
* Experience with cloud or big-data ecosystems, APIs, unstructured data, version control, and CI/CD practices
* Experience developing dashboards, decision-support tools, or other user-facing analytical products
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in projects, internships, or work environments
* Knowledge of automation platforms such as Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Zapier, or n8n

title: Data Scientist III, Analytics
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Data Scientist III, Analytics**

As a Data Scientist III, Analytics, you will independently lead analytical work that shapes decisions, improves performance, and scales better customer and business outcomes. You will combine technical expertise with business judgment to frame complex problems, develop robust analyses, and communicate clear recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Introduction to the Team**

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.
  
  
This role sits within our analytics organization and supports post-booking servicing experiences. You will use data, experimentation, and analytical thinking to improve traveler outcomes, inform product decisions, and deliver measurable business impact in partnership with product, analytics, and leadership stakeholders.

  
  
  

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead analytical projects or small work-streams from problem definition through recommendation, delivering insights that influence product and business decisions
* Extract, combine, and transform data from multiple sources to build reliable datasets for analysis, experimentation, and modeling
* Apply statistical methods, including regression, analysis of variance, hypothesis testing, and experiment design, to evaluate impact and solve business problems
* Use Structured Query Language (SQL), Python, R, or similar tools to analyze large datasets, develop scalable analytical approaches, and create clear visualisations
* Partner with subject matter experts and stakeholders to refine business questions, define success measures, and translate findings into practical recommendations
Document analytical work, share reproducible code, and provide guidance and feedback that helps strengthen the analytics community  

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* You have a bachelor's degree, master's degree, or doctorate in mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics, engineering, or related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience
* You have 5+ years of experience in a data analytics or data science role, delivering insights and recommendations that drove measurable change or performance improvement across multiple projects
* You have advanced experience using SQL, Python, R, or similar tools for data analysis, data structuring, transformation, and visualisation
* You have experience selecting measurement approaches for different business questions, including before-and-after analysis, causal inference, multivariate testing, or adaptive experimentation
* You have a strong grounding in statistical concepts and can apply experimentation, regression, and exploratory analysis to business questions
* You communicate analytical findings clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise and translate data into actionable recommendations
* You are comfortable working independently, managing priorities, and collaborating across functions to move analytical work forward
* You have experience working with large, complex datasets and understand challenges related to data quality, performance, and scalability
* You have working knowledge of machine learning concepts, including supervised learning methods such as linear regression, logistic regression, and clustering
* You create effective visualisations that prioritise clarity, accessibility, and audience needs
* You value iterative delivery, reproducibility, and knowledge sharing through documentation, dashboards, and reusable analytical workflows
* You have experience mentoring teammates, providing thoughtful feedback, and helping build analytical capability across a team

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior Director, AI Strategy & Support Innovation
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

About the Role

Sprinklr is seeking a visionary and results-oriented Senior Director, AI Strategy & Support Innovation to lead the transformation of our Support organization through Artificial Intelligence.

This leader will define and execute the long-term AI strategy for Support, serving as the key connection point between Support, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and business stakeholders. The role is responsible for identifying opportunities where AI can improve customer outcomes, increase operational efficiency, enhance employee productivity, and drive scalable growth across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in Support Operations, Product Strategy, AI-enabled transformation, and executive stakeholder management. They are equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy, influencing product roadmaps, building governance frameworks, and driving organizational adoption of innovative technologies.

This is a highly visible leadership role with direct accountability for the vision, roadmap, governance, adoption, and measurable business impact of AI initiatives across Support.

AI Strategy & Vision

  

* Define and maintain a multi-year AI strategy and roadmap for the Support organization.
* Identify emerging AI technologies and assess their potential impact on customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Develop investment and prioritization frameworks to ensure focus on the highest-value opportunities.
* Establish a long-term vision for AI-powered support capabilities, including intelligent automation, agent assistance, self-service,knowledge intelligence, and autonomous support solutions.

Product & Cross-Functional Leadership

  

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Business Operations teams to influence priorities and accelerate AI innovation.
* Translate support challenges and opportunities into scalable AI-powered solutions.
* Serve as an executive-level advocate for Support requirements within broader company AI initiatives.
* Drive alignment between Support's strategic objectives and enterprise AI investments.

Program Execution & Transformation

  

* Own the Support AI portfolio and ensure strategic initiatives are executed successfully.
* Define business requirements, success criteria, adoption strategies, and operational readiness plans.
* Lead change management efforts to drive organizational adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows.
* Establish repeatable processes for evaluating, piloting, and scaling AI solutions.

Measurement & Business Outcomes

  

* Define KPIs and success metrics to measure AI effectiveness and organizational impact.
* Develop executive dashboards and reporting frameworks to communicate progress and outcomes.
* Track business value through improvements in productivity, customer satisfaction, case resolution efficiency, quality, and cost-to-serve.

* Build ROI models and investment analyses for AI initiatives.

Governance & Responsible AI

  

* Establish governance frameworks that balance innovation, risk management, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
* Partner with Legal, Security, Compliance, and Product teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational standards.
* Develop policies and best practices for AI deployment, measurement, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  

* 10+ years of experience in Support Operations, Product Management, Customer Experience, Business Transformation, AI Strategy, or related leadership functions.
* 5+ years leading cross-functional programs or product initiatives at scale.
* Demonstrated experience defining and executing AI, automation, or digital transformation strategies.
* Strong understanding of customer support operating models, workflows, metrics, and technologies.
* Experience developing business cases, investment strategies, ROI frameworks, and executive-level reporting.
* Proven ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across multiple organizations.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Experience working within SaaS, customer support, customer experience, or enterprise software environments.
* Background in Product Management, AI/ML initiatives, Customer Support leadership, or Operations Strategy.
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions such as:
* Agent Assist
* Generative AI
* Conversational AI
* Intelligent Case Routing
* Knowledge Intelligence
* Workflow Automation
* Digital Self-Service
* Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI principles, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.
* MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

**We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

**EEO - Our philosophy**: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

References
  
  
Visible links
  
1. https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/
  
2. https://www.bain.com/careers/work-with-us/integrated-teams/ai-insights-solutions-ais/

title: Data Science GenAI Engineer
description:

* **2+ years of hands-on experience in Generative AI** , LLMs, or applied NLP.
* Strong programming skills in **Python** (required); experience with JavaScript/TypeScript is a plus.
* Practical experience with:
  + LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., OpenAI-compatible APIs, LangChain, LlamaIndex)
  + Prompt engineering and RAG architectures
  + Vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Chroma)

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
  

  

Who is Mastercard?  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

Overview  

The Security Solutions Data Science organization is looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager with an understanding of data science who is eager to take on the responsibility of managing a wide variety of data science projects. The person in this role will join a team of leading edge data scientists who are not just building models, but are working to solve fraud related problems for our customers through AI as a foundation for new product offerings.
  

  

Role  

The Technical Program Manager will interact with data scientists, product managers, engineers, and senior leaders across partner teams in the organization to deliver complex projects. You will define roadmap deliverables, develop execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, provide escalation management, make sound trade\-off decisions, and translate technical expressions into business terminology. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. You are expected to be detail\-oriented, with a solid technical background and excellent problem\-solving skills.  

All staff at Mastercard are expected to demonstrate 'Mastercard Way' cultural values every day \- own it, simplify it, sense of urgency, thoughtful risk\-taking, unlock potential, and be inclusive – with a relentless focus on our customers.
  

  

As a Senior Technical Program Manager for data science, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:  

* Primary liaison between product and data science, managing day\-to\-day planning and execution of data science projects through the entire engagement process, from business understanding through model deployment and monitoring
* Looked to as first point of contact for your teams or business line/service and the single source of truth for status, providing the correct information and associated data about the state of the project to the right audience at the right time with the right focus
* Build strong partnerships with product and technology teams and align esnure alignment with data science efforts
* Translate technical approaches and outcomes into business language
* Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program, or domain with depth to be credible and influential with teams they work with
* Clearly articulate scope, timelines, dependencies, owners, actions, risks, and mitigations. Report progress to teams and senior leadership in regular cadence, potentially representing segments of or the entire program
* Work with data scientists and engineering teams to build/improve ways of working and identify and mitigate risks or issues that may impact the plan
* Conducts meaningful retrospectives, creates action plans to implement changes at the team level

  

All about you  

It is not expected that any single candidate would have expertise across all these areas.  

* Experience with project management, operating autonomously across multiple teams, with demonstrated critical thinking, and thought leadership
* Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning, and building
* Help product, data science and engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. Identify blocking issues and manage their resolution
* Proven track record of data\-driven decision making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
* Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
* Excellent organization, interpersonal, administrative and problem solving skills
* Strong communication skills at all levels of the organization
* Capable of working independently but with a collaborative nature.
* Ability to navigate a matrix organization.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
